minecraft:diamond.answer: Look for diamond ore deep underground in the Overworld, below Y=16. It becomes more common toward the bottom of the world; around Y=-59 is a useful mining level, but watch for lava. Use an iron pickaxe or better to collect diamonds. They are not restricted to one Overworld biome.
conditions: Existing chunks reflect the version in which they generated

minecraft:coal.answer: Look for coal ore above Y=0 in the Overworld, especially exposed rock in hills, cliffs, and mountains. Higher ground is a better place to search than the deep negative-Y layers. Use a wooden pickaxe or better to collect it. If you are deep underground without coal, you can make charcoal by smelting suitable logs instead.
conditions: Deepslate coal at the boundary is a rare special case
